authorized_by: user (chat: '给预算，请你添加进执行列表' + scope pick 'H48+H64 各3k')
authorization_type: NEW optimizer budget for H-HORIZON-STUDY, explicit cap

scope.eval: 10-seed official per horizon (added to the same 6000? NO - eval is inference, not optimizer steps)
scope.data_window_default: 9-frame reuse (H48=6:1, H64=8:1 action:transition); new 48/64-step action windows from the same 20fps raw data; NO new force/label signal semantics
scope.data_window_note: 13/17-frame 4:1 rebuild NOT chosen (higher risk); can be revisited
scope.hard_stop: each run stops at its 3000 cap; no auto-continue to 6k without a new grant

gating.first_run: H0_ZEROTRAIN_H_PROBE (budget 0) MUST run first: load F2 15k, infer H=32/48/64 on identical start frames, judge whether positions 32+ are usable or garbage
gating.train_only_if: H0 shows the beyond-32 tail is unusable (expected: positions 32+ were never trained). If H0 shows the tail is usable, we may execute longer chunks WITHOUT retraining and the 6000-step budget is not spent
gating.gpu_order: after F0 15k hard stop (F0 has priority now); single-GPU exclusive lock

what_this_is_not: not an authorization to resume F2 15800->21000 (that stays BLOCKED_USER)
not an authorization to change the official H32/r10 protocol for existing scores
not a claim that zero-training H48/H64 is a valid capability; it is exploratory OOD until shown otherwise
remaining_gpu_hours: console-gated; user must refresh if the H study risks the rental window
